title: Close the Loop: No Change Needed
subtitle: Sometimes the catalog is already right
scenario: Turn the archived run into feedback. This time the role needed the handheld scanner - and the catalog already added it last quarter (it is inProfile now). The honest feedback is: no catalog change needed. Confirming the profile is right is as valid a loop outcome as proposing a change.
input: Archive note for hire H-4022 (Logistics Coordinator): the hire needed the handheld scanner, which the catalog already lists (inProfile = true, added v1.1.0). The only friction was a hardware backorder - a supply issue, not a profile gap. Feedback: proposedChange = none, routed to the People Ops Lead for the record.
instructions: Record the role and what the hire needed.
Note that it was already in the profile (inProfile true).
Set proposedChange to none and route it to the catalog owner.
Return one valid JSON object, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Build one JSON profile-feedback record: role, needed (handheld scanner), inProfile true (already added), proposedChange none, routedTo People Ops Lead. The catalog was already right.
successMessage: Loop closed with 'no change'. Confirming the catalog is right is a real outcome.
editorHelper: No change is a valid, honest conclusion.

sections.title: Not every run demands a change
sections.body: Last quarter's feedback already added the scanner. This run confirms that fix worked - the role needed it and had it. 'No change needed' is a real, valuable loop outcome.

sections.title: Separate the profile from the supply issue
sections.body: The friction here was a backorder, not a missing entitlement. Good feedback routes each problem to the right place: the catalog was fine; supply is a different lever.

sections.title: Still routed and recorded
sections.body: Even a 'no change' goes to the People Ops Lead for the record. The loop is auditable whether it proposes or confirms.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A feedback record that confirms the catalog is right - closing the loop without churn.

takeaway.heading: Loop closed - no change
points: You confirmed the catalog already had what the role needed.
You separated the profile (right) from the supply issue (a backorder).
'No change needed' is a valid, honest loop outcome.
The confirmation is still routed and recorded for audit.
The workflow can now close the loop by confirming the catalog, not only by changing it.
